overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong cross-platform academic presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon with a combined total of 3,580 followers. Engagement is consistently high across all platforms, particularly driven by major announcements such as new research papers, grant wins, software tool updates, and hiring opportunities in computational social science and disinformation research.

contentThemes.description: Research findings, tools like CooRnet, and conference presentations on detecting coordinated campaigns.
Announcements regarding newly published papers, grants awarded, and conference presentations.
Recruitment posts for postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in computational social science.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on Mastodon and LinkedIn to match audience size and potential reach.
Cross-post high-engagement academic calls (like PhD/Postdoc opportunities) across all three platforms simultaneously.
Utilize direct media (images, link previews, paper summaries) to further boost engagement on milestone announcements.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest average engagement rate (6.14%), driven strongly by paper announcements and higher repost ratios.
platformInsights.mastodon: Niche, highly focused audience around software tools (CooRnet) and academic discussions, showing solid interaction despite smaller follower count.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest professional audience (1,850 followers) with high volume of raw interactions, performing exceptionally well for grant wins and job postings.
